rule.primaryMetric: median seed source-group macro average precision
rule.rule: Select causal multiview only if its median spatial-group macro AP exceeds single-frame by at least 0.02; otherwise select single-frame. Candidate must also have every-seed pooled AP >= 0.50, recognize at least P-1 of P positive spatial groups at its calibrated threshold, frame recall >= 0.70, and zero observed development false positives.
rule.thresholdRule: Among unique pooled out-of-fold scores, choose the lowest threshold with zero observed negative predictions; ties maximize frame recall then precision. This is a development operating point, not proof of zero future risk.

historicalReference.reproductionLimitation: Historical P2 did not persist per-frame OOF predictions. Final-refit checkpoint predictions are not substituted for historical OOF evidence.
